verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Tap to Pay on iPhone solution for accepting contactless in-person payments on an iPhone, under a docs path for building on mobile iOS. Smartphones and tablets can also be turned into Tap to Pay checkouts. However, the evidence never explicitly names an official mobile SDK that you embed in your own app, and Android is not mentioned. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official embeddable iOS SDK, any Android SDK evidence, integration depth (installation, APIs, sample apps), independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed in-person payments into my own iOS or Android app with official mobile SDKs

citations.quote: With our Tap to Pay on iPhone solution you can accept contactless in-person payments using an iPhone as the payment interface, and process these payments on the Adyen payments platform.
Turn compatible smartphones or tablets into Tap to Pay checkouts. No extra hardware required.
